item.title: What `apt upgrade` Actually Does
item.description: apt upgrade does not update the system version. item.title: Display Rupiah Values Beautifully with formatCompact()
item.description: Ever noticed how Instagram shows "1.2M likes" instead of "1,200,000 likes"? That's compact formatting - and your Indonesian apps need it too. Large numbers like Rp 1.500.000.000 take up too much space and are hard to read at a glance. That's why I built formatCompact() in @indodev/toolkit - it formats Rupiah using Indonesian units: ribu, juta, miliar, triliun.
